conditions: Offline deterministic sample: all 33 cards, Lv1/Lv10 bare and affinity solo round robin, seeds 73/211 mirrored by actual team ids; matched 3v3 teammates across frontline/ranged/sustain contexts with mirrored sides; six-player FFA with rotated spawn ids. Team rows measure only the focal slot. 180s timeout; unfinished games never get a fabricated winner. Survival means HP > 0 at the end, including units on losing teams. Support separates allies from self; buff/control seconds are unique source-target ticks, not sum of overlapping statuses. Wilson intervals describe this sample and do not remove systematic matchup/seed bias.
